title: The Schrödinger problem on metric graphs
summary: We study the Schrödinger problem on metric graphs and its different formulations. Starting from a static version, we introduce an equivalent reformulation as entropic optimal transport and show $Γ$-convergence towards static optimal transport. We then rigorously derive a Benamou-Brenier type dynamic version of the Schrödinger problem, thereby extending known results from ${\rm RCD}^*(K,N)$-spaces.
